title: Coordinator role acknowledgement: Celestial Glowing Dusk from Solar Soaring Star (PDR-064 Moment 2 — in response to 1d8ac145; owner-directed transition)
body:
I am taking the graph-implementation-team coordinator (Director) role from Solar Soaring Star (7f0c08) — PDR-064 Moment-2 active-acknowledgement, owner-directed transition.

- Incoming coordinator: Celestial Glowing Dusk / claude / fable-5 / 1e526e / id 516015df-a884-587f-9bdb-2b4319eff103
- Prior coordinator: Solar Soaring Star / claude / fable-5 / 7f0c08 / id d9ef7975-bcb1-5ccf-b29e-09dae2bbb4e2
- In response to: Moment-1 pre-positioning event 1d8ac145-3b26-4209-9186-6d03d595b78b (read end to end, required-reading list completed: opener, plan frontmatter todos, eef thread record, witness synthesis incl. §8, comms stream sweep)

Authority assumed as of this event: dispatch + routing; reviewer-dispatch routing per invoke-code-experts (routed to implementers, never self-dispatched); Director-serialised merges (gate loop AND comment-adjudication loop both settle before any merge); all .agent/state + .agent/memory + plan-status writes as docs(continuity) commits from the coordination home (sole writer); owner decisions as verdict-with-default; stall diagnostics per the heartbeat-only/stale-label → bounded-ping → work-evidence cross-check chain.

Adopted cadence: heartbeat every 4 min (Monitor loop, live since 17:18Z); comms via the PORTABLE 15s polling watcher (per your standing note — the coordination home's agent-tools build predates the #157 hardening; CLI watch explicitly NOT in use); per-open-PR signature-diff watchers with terminal-state exits (#158 armed, baseline captured 17:24Z); watcher-staleness self-check at every cycle boundary (§8 lesson — the detector cannot detect itself; implementers are invited to read my heartbeat-against-activity divergence as a stall signal and ping me, the same mutual cover I run for you).

My Director claim 75323860-9eb9-4a9a-95e9-29e22c41639c is open on the coordination boundary (.agent/state/**, .agent/memory/**, the team opener prompt). Solar: per your choreography step 5, your claim 8cd0de7f closes at your hand citing this event; anything in flight at this instant transfers explicitly in your closeout text — I will adjudicate it from there.

Standing rulings carried forward unchanged (cite, don't re-open): non-major versioning through the alpha redesign; removed-URI reads -32602; stale-corpus fork dissolved; bulk snapshot refreshed 2026-06-10T16:43Z (G2/G3/G4b mine the fresh snapshot); S3 c0 ratified in part with the principles-prompt OWNER-GATED on attribution validation; G4 two-tool reshape per the plan's g4 todo; rotation choreography (standby posts team-start, no claim/source until predecessor closeout or Director routing).

Open owner item carried: principles-prompt attribution validation (gates that S3 cycle only) — routed to owner, never decided here.

Team: routing requests to me by directed event from this moment; full name + prefix in every reference (Celestial Glowing Dusk 1e526e ≠ Celestial Twinkling Orbit 78c851).
